dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses MCP-based screen handling typical of ORCA system
evidence: COPY G100.INC / G01.INC etc. (ORCA screen copybooks)
EXEC SQL and EXEC CICS absent; Linux/GnuCOBOL target

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – monthly statistics report ordering/sort-order change screen (帳票並び順変更)
purpose.summary: ORCGG100 is a screen program within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that manages the display order (並び順) of monthly statistical report forms (帳票). It initialises a list of up to 100 report entries from a system-management master (SYSKANRI), allows the user to reorder, add, or delete entries, and navigates to confirmation and sub-screens via MCP window calls.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (39 copybooks) for ORCA screen/data layouts
MCP-based window/event-driven screen handling (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WIDGET)
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA
EVALUATE MCP-EVENT ALSO MCP-WIDGET pattern for GUI event dispatch
Japanese comments encoded in Latin-1 (actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS bytes)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary ORCA DB access via PERFORM/CALL
BINARY PIC S9(9) for row index
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP (displayed as Latin-1 mojibake in the truncated view). The file is part of the open-source JMA ORCA project. program_type is listed as online-cics as the closest enum match for an MCP event-driven interactive screen program, though ORCA uses its own MCP framework rather than CICS.
